## `client.column_masks`

The `column-masks` resource of the platform API.

### `client.column_masks.create`

Signature: `client.column_masks.create(*, principal: str | None = None, group: str | None = None, environment: str, namespace: str, table: str, column: str, expression: str, override_reason: str | None = None) -> ColumnMask`

Create a column mask.

Exactly one of `principal`/`group` must be given; the server raises `ValidationError` otherwise, and validates `expression` against the mask grammar (the restricted subset plus `substr`/`substring`/`||`/`md5`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str | None` | `None` | Name of the principal this mask applies to, or `None` if applying to a group. |
| `group` | `str | None` | `None` | Name of the group this mask applies to, or `None` if applying to a principal. |
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment the masked table lives in. |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The dot-joined namespace path, such as `"gold.sales"`. |
| `table` | `str` | required | The table name. |
| `column` | `str` | required | The masked column's name. |
| `expression` | `str` | required | The replacement value. |
| `override_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line, to create the column mask although an access file manages its scope (an audited override, for an administrator of the instance). |

Returns: `ColumnMask`. The created column mask.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If neither or both of `principal`/`group` is given, or `expression` fails validation. |
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the named principal, group, or table does not exist. |

### `client.column_masks.list`

Signature: `client.column_masks.list(*, principal_name: str | None = None, group_name: str | None = None, environment: str | None = None, namespace: str | None = None, table: str | None = None) -> list[ColumnMask]`

List column masks for a principal, a group, or a specific table.

Exactly one of `principal_name`/`group_name`/(`environment`+ `namespace`+`table` together) must be given.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal_name` | `str | None` | `None` | List this principal's own direct masks. |
| `group_name` | `str | None` | `None` | List this group's own direct masks. |
| `environment` | `str | None` | `None` | The environment to match, for a table-scoped listing. |
| `namespace` | `str | None` | `None` | The dot-joined namespace to match, for a table-scoped listing. |
| `table` | `str | None` | `None` | The table to match, for a table-scoped listing. |

Returns: `list of ColumnMask`. The matching column masks.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If none of the valid parameter combinations is given. |

### `client.column_masks.revoke`

Signature: `client.column_masks.revoke(column_mask_id: str, *, override_reason: str | None = None) -> None`

Revoke a column mask.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `column_mask_id` | `str` | required | The column mask's id. |
| `override_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line, to revoke the column mask although an access file manages its scope (an audited override, for an administrator of the instance). |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no column mask of this id exists. |
